readmeExcerpt: This module demonstrates hybrid search with plain JDBC on Oracle AI Database. The sample stores product-style documents with:
highlights: a text content field that is embedded locally with the same MiniLM model style used in ai-vector-search
a JSON resource file that seeds a larger sample catalog dynamically at runtime
a VECTOR embedding column for semantic similarity
relational columns such as category and price
metaTitle: JDBC Hybrid Search | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Plain JDBC hybrid search sample that combines Oracle Text, vectors, JSON, and relational filters.
